items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Yeah, Tony made a couple of them parades with us over in the Bronx or two of them Finman Day parades.

ctx.x: Yeah, Tony Jardina was a real fine clarinet. Oh yeah. You ought to hear this guy play clarinet. That was the first, I guess, real professional band I'd ever played with. I was only about 14, 15 years old.
Yeah, Tony made a couple of them parades with us over in the Bronx or two of them Finman Day parades.
Well, there's so many people like that that have forgotten. Like you were talking about Ricky Tom. I don't even know where he was from.
